На диске — только идентичность самой нод: On disk there is only the node's own identity (its WireGuard key, number, network parameters). No user data: keys and devices come from the panel after every reboot. Full-disk encryption isn't in place yet — it's on the roadmap.

После отключения устройства или прекраще: After a device disconnects or access ends, session-related data is not kept on the node: it lives only in RAM and is never written to disk.
Мы намеренно не ведём warrant canary — и: We deliberately run no warrant canary — and never pass off a non-existent signature as a real one. Mullvad runs none either (their reasoning is jurisdictional: by their account Swedish law already can't secretly compel a provider to act against its users, so a canary would add nothing), and neither does AirVPN, which considers its effectiveness questionable. Here is our own reasoning, stated as ours: a recurring canary tends to degenerate into a ritual — easy to perform formally, hard to verify from outside, and any hiccup in the schedule spreads panic for no reason. There is a counter-example too — IVPN keeps a live canary as a monthly attestation: a different, workable design; we simply chose to report by fact.
Наша защита от принуждения — не декларац: Our protection against coercion is not a declaration but the architecture. After a powered-off node is seized, or after a reboot, no user data remains:

Подарочный код — предоплаченный доступ в: A gift code is prepaid access in the form of a string. It is not a means of payment, it carries no monetary value and it is not exchangeable for money, in whole or in part.

Мы вправе отключить код или партию кодов: We may switch off a code, or a batch of codes, before redemption — for instance if the batch was compromised or obtained without payment. Days already credited are not affected.
